name: King George
positioning: King George, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Athens: a hotel dating back to 1930 on Syntagma Square, within walking distance of the Acropolis sites, Plaka and Monastiraki
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable central base for the Acropolis, Plaka and Monastiraki
Art lovers interested in contemporary Greek painting
Guests who want a penthouse suite with a private outdoor pool facing the Acropolis

facts.text: King George Hotel dates back to 1930 and sits in the heart of Syntagma Square.
The hotel is within walking distance of heritage sites such as the Parthenon, Acropolis Hill, the New Acropolis Museum and the Ancient Agora.
The Monastiraki Flea Market is less than a mile from the hotel.
All rooms have oversized windows, hand-picked antiques, classic cornicing, hardwood floors and silk drapes.
Each room has a marble-lined en-suite bathroom with a rainfall shower, and many have a bathtub.
Rooms have The Luxury Collection Bed dressed in custom Frette linen.
The Penthouse Suite's adjacent terrace has sitting and dining areas.
Paintings by Greek artists such as Pavlos Samios and Kostis Georgiou, and the Golden Olive Trees by Constantinos Valaes, are displayed in the hotel.
Visitors can buy the displayed artworks through the artists' representative at the hotel.
At George, The Lobby Bar, signature cocktails crafted around a zero-waste philosophy are prepared tableside.
The concierge team arranges private tours of landmarks such as the New Acropolis Museum, the Archaeological Museum, the Benaki Museum and the Byzantine Museum.
Disposable bottles, high chairs and safe bed railings are available on request for children.

highlights.text: The two-bedroom Penthouse Suite has a private outdoor pool with views of the Acropolis and the city from the ninth floor.
The hotel presents a rotating collection of artworks by Greek artists.
Tudor Hall is the hotel's rooftop restaurant and cocktail bar, pairing neo-classical decor with seventh-floor views of the Acropolis.
The lobby features Murano chandeliers and bright marbles.
The Luxury Collection Concierge, Apostolos Papayiannakis, is a bilingual certified destination expert and a Les Clefs d'Or member.

considerations.text: The hotel does not offer on-site parking.
Suites offer city-center views or overlook the hotel's atrium.
WhataHotel notes the central location on busy Syntagma Square can bring urban noise.
